title: The 3 Best Deep Fryers for Small Kitchens
h1: The 3 Best Deep Fryers for Small Kitchens
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for deep fryers for small kitchens, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at deep fryers for small kitchens using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Presto Dual Daddy Electric Deep Fryer
products.blurb: Key specs: Compact 9 x 14 x 8.5-inch footprint, Dual-well design with removable divider, 1500W element.
strengths: Smallest footprint on this list at roughly 9 by 14 inches
Snap-on lid lets you store oil directly in the unit, no separate container needed
Nonstick cast aluminum wipes clean fast in a kitchen without much counter space to work in
Dual wells still allow two small batches without a bigger fryer
limitations: 1500W element is the slowest to recover on this list
No digital timer or viewing window
features: Snap-on cover doubles as oil storage lid

products.name: T-fal Ultimate EZ Clean Deep Fryer
products.blurb: Key specs: 3.5-liter oil / 2.6-pound food capacity, 1700W element, Digital timer and temperature control.
strengths: 1700W element heats up quickly despite the compact stainless steel housing
Digital timer and temperature control fit a lot of function into a small unit
Locking lid keeps splatter contained on a tight counter
Built-in filtration means less oil to store between uses
limitations: Stainless housing runs slightly larger than the Presto's footprint
Filtration adds a couple minutes to cleanup versus a basic wipe-down

products.name: Cuisinart CDF-200P1 Professional Deep Fryer
products.blurb: Key specs: 1-gallon removable stainless steel oil container, 1800W immersion heating element, 2.3-pound food capacity.
strengths: 2.3-pound food capacity is large for a unit that still fits on a standard counter
Removable oil container simplifies storage between uses in a small kitchen
Pour-spout container avoids a mess when disposing of oil at a small sink
1800W element compensates for a compact housing with fast heat-up
limitations: Larger footprint than the Presto or T-fal, closer to 11 by 14 inches
Single basket, no dual-well option for splitting foods
features: Adjustable temperature dial with viewing window

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
